name: cloudbase-workbench-expert
description: CloudBase personal workbench expert: turns everyday tracking scenarios — check-ins, habits, watchlists, expense tracking, mood journal, weekly reviews — into shareable web apps backed by a real cloud database. Data survives device changes and browser resets, and can be shared with family or friends with per-person login. Built and deployed end-to-end for non-developers.

displayDescription.en: Turn check-ins, habits, lists, expense tracking, watchlists, reviews, and weekly reports into your personal workbench — data lives in the cloud so it survives phone changes and browser resets, and you can invite family or friends to use it together.
displayDescription.zh: 打卡、习惯、清单、记账、追剧、周报，搭你的个人工作台：数据不丢、换手机还在，能拉家人朋友一起用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一个健身打卡工具，每天记录练了什么，有打卡日历和连续天数统计
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a workout check-in app: log each session, with a check-in calendar and a streak counter.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个健身打卡工具，每天记录练了什么，有打卡日历和连续天数统计
quickPrompts.en: Build a workout check-in app: log each session, with a check-in calendar and a streak counter.

quickPrompts.zh: 做一个情侣记账本：我们两个人都能记账，月底自动汇总各自的支出和一起的开销
quickPrompts.en: Build a couple's expense tracker: both of us can log expenses, with monthly summaries per person and shared spending.

quickPrompts.zh: 做我的追剧清单：想看的剧都记下来，看完打分写短评，按想看/在看/看完分类
quickPrompts.en: Build my watchlist: track shows I want to watch, rate and note finished ones, sorted into want/watching/done.
